coverage.scope: Finite complete delimiter inventory plus parameterized local GPT-OSS chat grammar; not finite enumeration of arbitrary content/headers/conversations.

categories.content_type_and_format: generic constrain header plus local renderer ordinary header label

grammar.message: near(start) author [to=recipient] [near(channel) channel [to=recipient]] [content_type] near(message) body near(end|return|call)
grammar.author: system | developer | user | assistant | arbitrary tool name
grammar.dynamic_api: render_message(role, body, channel, recipient, content_type, end, style, tool_name, recipient_after_channel)
grammar.conversations: arbitrary concatenation of messages and optional partial generation header

coverage.local_vs_harmony_alias_note: HF calls ID 200018 endofprompt; local Harmony calls it reserved_200018. Both spellings are approximated/excluded.

grammar.note: Generic Harmony structured-output header; local default renderer uses plain format labels
